The Mercury role column header is a plain div with a click handler that sorts the table, no tabindex, no role and no aria-sort, and a 64-stop Tab walk never lands on it, so keyboard users cannot sort by it (2.1.1). Sorting is a convenience: all rows stay readable and keyboard users can narrow the list by role, status and department through the Add filter menu, so the impact is minor.
